title: accordion-task-lists: plan→list with pins and attachments

goals.text: The accordion-task-lists skill teaches how and why to attach plan, spec and research sections and pin rules on list and task scopes, with a worked plan→list example.
Hand-authored lists can carry pins and attachments that the validator resolves against the project, and a symlinked list in .pig/tasks survives store writes.
Changes verified (tests, smoke, validator on examples) and committed on a branch off feat/pi-native.

report.outcome: Orientation done; gaps mapped and implementation tasks 2–6 added.

subtasks.title: Map store reference handling: file format, tool input, delivery, symlink writes

report.outcome: Mapped gaps: skill tells agents to prefer the tool for refs and never explains them; parser requires pin/attachment ids and pin `at` (spec §2.1 says authors may omit ids); quote anchors need prefix/suffix/start by hand; validate.mjs checks structure only, never resolves refs; store write (tmp+rename, tasks.ts:428) replaces a symlinked list; projectPath() (taskPins.ts) rejects any file outside the project incl. the KB; nukular lists have zero pins/attachments and its plans/AGENTS.md says copy, not symlink.
decisions: Allowed external roots via user setting, default empty — committed lists must not exfiltrate arbitrary files (spec rationale for the in-project rule)
